node.title: Re: problem with simple STDIN to UART script
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: You might be interested in my post [id://1183290] where I showed several examples using [mod://IO::Termios], as well as this module that I wrote that uses [doc://IO::Select], which you can use for timeouts and non-blocking reads (not published on CPAN because I haven't done enough testing IMO, but it seems to work so far): [https://bitbucket.org/haukex/hgpstools/src/HEAD/SerialPort.pm|SerialPort.pm]
